name: Mcp Panel
description: 专为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的功能扩展插件，提供免配置一键安装与高效开发辅助。
descriptionEn: MCP management console for the official DeepSeek Harness MCP client: /mcp command with health diagnostics and pipeline trial calls, a Settings MCP tab with server CRUD (approval-gated writes, automatic backups) and a tool trial console over the official tool pipeline (Apache-2.0, dsh-plugin).
author: MingLin
